name: fis-experiment-recommender
description: Maps AWS DevOps Agent resilience findings to AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) experiments: classifies the failure category, selects the matching FIS action, sets a conservative duration and a tag/COUNT-scoped non-production-first target, and defines a CloudWatch stop condition, prioritized by finding severity. Read-only and recommend-only - it designs experiments for a human to review and run, never injects a fault. Recommends the awslabs FIS-recommender MCP server as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on WED at 08:00 UTC
